note: Shortcut tone curves for flp_master_tone(preset=...): gentle, genre-neutral starting points for the master's Fruity Parametric EQ 2, not anyone's taste. Bands: type peak | low_shelf | high_shelf | high_pass | low_pass, hz, gain_db, q. Override or add presets in <fl-headless state folder>/master_tone.json (same layout; a preset there replaces the shipped one of that name). Always listen: a master curve changes every instrument.

clean.description: less low-mid mud, a little more air

warm.description: fuller lows, softer upper mids and top

bright.description: a lighter low-mid, more presence and air
